settings.name: USE_LDAP
settings.description: Enable or disable LDAP SSO authentication.

settings.name: LDAP_HOST
settings.description: LDAP server hostname or IP address.

settings.name: LDAP_PORT
settings.description: LDAP server port (389 for LDAP/STARTTLS, 636 for LDAPS).

settings.name: LDAP_LDAPS
settings.description: Use LDAPS (TLS from connection start).

settings.name: LDAP_STARTTLS
settings.description: Use STARTTLS upgrade on LDAP connection.

settings.name: LDAP_SSL_VERIFY
settings.description: Verify server TLS certificate.

settings.name: LDAP_TIMEOUT
settings.description: LDAP socket timeout in milliseconds.

settings.name: LDAP_KEEPALIVE_TIMEOUT
settings.description: LDAP keepalive timeout in milliseconds.

settings.name: LDAP_KEEPALIVE_POOL_SIZE
settings.description: LDAP keepalive connection pool size.

settings.name: LDAP_KEEPALIVE_POOL_NAME
settings.description: Optional custom LDAP keepalive pool name.

settings.name: LDAP_BIND_DN
settings.description: Optional service account DN used to perform LDAP user searches.

settings.name: LDAP_BIND_PASSWORD
settings.description: Password for LDAP Bind DN service account.

settings.name: LDAP_USER_SEARCH_BASE_DN
settings.description: Base DN for user discovery search (enables enterprise search mode when set).

settings.name: LDAP_USER_SEARCH_FILTER
settings.description: LDAP user search filter template. Use {username} placeholder.

settings.name: LDAP_AUTHZ_FILTER
settings.description: Optional extra LDAP authorization filter (AND-ed with user search filter).

settings.name: LDAP_USER_SEARCH_SCOPE
settings.description: LDAP search scope for user lookup.

settings.name: LDAP_USER_SEARCH_DEREF_ALIASES
settings.description: LDAP alias dereferencing mode during user lookup.

settings.name: LDAP_USER_SEARCH_SIZE_LIMIT
settings.description: Maximum number of LDAP entries returned by user search.

settings.name: LDAP_USER_SEARCH_TIME_LIMIT
settings.description: Maximum LDAP user search time in seconds.

settings.name: LDAP_USER_SEARCH_ATTRIBUTES
settings.description: Attributes requested during user search (space separated).

settings.name: LDAP_USER_SEARCH_DN_FIELD
settings.description: Preferred field name in search response to extract user DN (e.g. object_name, dn).

settings.name: LDAP_USER_SEARCH_REQUIRE_UNIQUE
settings.description: Require exactly one search result before authenticating user.

settings.name: LDAP_USER_DN_TEMPLATE
settings.description: User DN template used for direct bind fallback. Must include {username} when set.

settings.name: LDAP_USERNAME_REGEX
settings.description: PCRE regex used to validate submitted usernames.

settings.name: LDAP_LOGIN_PATH
settings.description: Login page path exposed by the LDAP plugin.

settings.name: LDAP_LOGOUT_PATH
settings.description: Logout path exposed by the LDAP plugin.

settings.name: LDAP_SESSION_TTL
settings.description: LDAP session validity duration in seconds.

settings.name: LDAP_REALM
settings.description: Authentication realm displayed on LDAP login form.

settings.name: LDAP_USER_HEADER
settings.description: Header to pass authenticated username to upstream (empty to disable).

settings.name: LDAP_EMAIL_HEADER
settings.description: Header to pass the user email to upstream (empty to disable). Requires search mode and the email attribute returned by the directory.

settings.name: LDAP_EMAIL_ATTRIBUTE
settings.description: LDAP attribute used for the email header (e.g. mail).

settings.name: LDAP_GROUPS_HEADER
settings.description: Header to pass the user groups to upstream (empty to disable). Requires search mode and the groups attribute returned by the directory.

settings.name: LDAP_GROUPS_ATTRIBUTE
settings.description: LDAP attribute used for the groups header (e.g. memberOf).

settings.name: LDAP_GROUPS_VALUE
settings.description: How to serialize group values: 'cn' forwards only the first RDN value (group name, recommended with a comma separator), 'dn' forwards full group DNs (use a non-comma separator since DNs contain commas).

settings.name: LDAP_GROUPS_SEPARATOR
settings.description: Separator used to join multiple group values in the groups header.

settings.name: LDAP_NAME_HEADER
settings.description: Header to pass the user display name to upstream (empty to disable). Requires search mode and the display name attribute returned by the directory.

settings.name: LDAP_NAME_ATTRIBUTE
settings.description: LDAP attribute used for the display name header (e.g. displayName, cn).

settings.name: LDAP_REDIRECT_AFTER_LOGIN
settings.description: Fallback relative path after successful login when no redirect target is provided.

settings.name: LDAP_REDIRECT_AFTER_LOGOUT
settings.description: Relative path to redirect users to after logout.
